column2: 2 tilesets are built into the game (their pictures are in the game folder)

They display normally in the game. The editor does not have these pictures and uses same-color blocks instead; editing and saving are not affected. To see the real pictures, pick the .png (and .tsx) files from the game's assets/tilesets.
They reference external files and may not show on another device or for other people. Pick the matching .tsx and .png to embed them into the map.
The editor uses same-color blocks instead, and the game may not find it on another device. Pick the matching .tsx and .png to embed it into the map.
This map's tilesets had no terrain annotations; they were completed from the tile assets saved on this device (export_ground) and will be written into the map when saved
2 tilesets have no picture and are shown as same-color blocks for now; to add pictures use "Map → Fill in missing tile pictures"
No command center spawns (units come from triggers)
This map has 3 "spawn units" triggers, so units may be handed out by triggers at the start. Make sure every team starts with units, otherwise it loses at once.
The game ignores this link and nothing breaks (some maps deliberately keep unused names). If it is a typo or the trigger was deleted, you can remove it in one tap.
